Ui.Script: -- Ref Cooldown.lua's CooldownFrame_SetTimer, transcribed: show-and-arm only when all three -- are positive, else hide. function CooldownFrame_SetTimer(this, start, duration, enable) if ( start > 0 and duration > 0 and enable > 0 ) then this:SetCooldown(start, duration) this:Show() else this:Hide() end end
